plugins.name: fly-cli
plugins.description: Launch and deploy apps on Fly.io through flyctl, signed in with a token kept on the host.
plugins.author: Akalstack

plugins.name: grafana-data
plugins.description: Read Grafana data sources in Ramu dashboards with a Viewer service account token.
plugins.author: Akalstack

plugins.name: amplitude-data
plugins.description: Read Amplitude event counts in Ramu dashboards with a project's API key and secret key.
plugins.author: Akalstack

plugins.name: salesforce-data
plugins.description: Read Salesforce records with SOQL in Ramu dashboards, through your own connected app's sign-in.
plugins.author: Akalstack

plugins.name: meshy
plugins.description: Make textured, rigged and animated 3D models for games with Meshy, on your Meshy API key.
plugins.author: Akalstack

plugins.name: tripo
plugins.description: Make 3D models for games with Tripo from a description or a picture, and rig and animate them, on your Tripo API key.
plugins.author: Akalstack

plugins.name: godot
plugins.description: Build, check and export Godot 4 games through the godot command, including a web export that publishes like any static site.
plugins.author: Akalstack
